pass_a_gloss:
It is not possible, but from God's energy, from the highest one's oversight, from the Spirit's presence. Therefore, when the virgin said to Gabriel: 'How will this be for me, since I do not know a man?' That is, 'I am overwhelmed by the wonder, I am overcome by the word', and the angel's message astonishes the virgin. 'You speak astonishing things, but I am suspicious because of the strangeness. I fear the evangelism's newness, I am disturbed by the extraordinary things being said. How will this be for me, since I do not know a man? How will I be a mother without being a bride? I have not touched the flower of my prime, I have not loosened the belt of my virginity, I have not broken the seal of my womb. The angel immediately replied: 'The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you', that is, 'If you had known a man, you would not have borne God, who wished to take on the form of a servant from you without corruption. But since you are a pure bridal bed, since you have kept the temple uncorrupted and the tent free from all defilement, the Father dwells in you, the Spirit overshadows you, and the Only-Begotten is born from you in the flesh.

You, then, do not separate the following mysteries, do not separate in a cave giving birth to the creator of all creation, do not separate in a manger sitting the one sitting on the cherubim, not having a place in the inn and being a mother of the king of those above and below; for he willingly becomes poor out of you, so that he may also humble the rich, and become a model of endurance and a teacher of gratitude for the poor; he willingly places himself in the manger, so that the animal-like ones may run to him and find the Logos sitting in the manger, so that they may take from him the rational dignity, so that they may find bread having expected straw, so that like animals they may run to the manger to find the grain of wheat and eat the true bread, the food of life, the dinner of light, the nourishment of joy, the sweetness of incorruptibility, from which is the knowledge of the kingdom, the pledge of adoption, the lot of the heavens, the communion of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit
pass_b_english: The virgin's question to Gabriel, 'How will this be for me, since I do not know a man?' (Luke 1:34), reveals her astonishment and perplexity at the angel's message.
She is overwhelmed by the wonder of it all and is struggling to comprehend the extraordinary things being said to her.
Her innocence and purity are evident in her words, as she protests that she has not touched the flower of her prime and has kept the temple of her body uncorrupted.
The angel's immediate response, 'The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you,' (Luke 1:35), provides the answer to the virgin's question.
This response highlights the miraculous nature of the conception and the role of the Holy Spirit in it.
The angel's words also emphasize the virgin's purity and her suitability to bear the Only-Begotten Son of God, who wished to take on the form of a servant from her without corruption.

You must not separate the mysteries that follow, for in a cave, you give birth to the creator of all creation, and in a manger, you sit with the one who sits on the cherubim, without a place in the inn, yet you are the mother of the king of those above and below.
For he willingly becomes poor out of you, so that he may also humble the rich, and become a model of endurance and a teacher of gratitude for the poor.

He willingly places himself in the manger, so that the animal-like ones may run to him and find the Logos sitting in the manger, and take from him the rational dignity, so that they may find bread having expected straw, and eat the true bread, the food of life, the dinner of light, the nourishment of joy, and the sweetness of incorruptibility, which gives the knowledge of the kingdom, the pledge of adoption, the lot of the heavens, and the communion of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
